MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.

Douglas Robbins, Esq. appeared for the plaintiff Schapiro-Thorn, Inc., a California corp.
Plaintiff's Witness Suzy Thorn and Rita Gong were sworn and direct examined.
No appearance by defaulted defendant Sean Timmons.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants as follows:

Damages $93,722.00
Prejudgment Interest $3,905.08
Costs $515.00 for a total judgment in the amount of $98,142.08
Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
